name: armazenador-de-senhas-mobile
description: Cofre de senhas 100% offline-first para Android. Criptografia AES-256-GCM nativa, zero rastreamento, zero nuvem.

author.name: Milton Rogério De Souza Nogueira Junior

copyright: Copyright (c) 2026 Milton Rogério De Souza Nogueira Junior

scripts.build:apk: npx cap copy android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && mkdir -p "Security Keys" && mv android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk "Security Keys/Security-Keys.apk"
scripts.build:apk:win: npx cap copy android && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && if not exist "Security Keys" mkdir "Security Keys" && move /Y android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk "Security Keys\Security-Keys.apk"
scripts.setup:android: npx cap add android && npm run generate:icons && npx cap copy android
